liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Lumpy Beanpole & Dirt** (1 other source): Uploader identifies this song as a cover of a Bad Livers tune [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **Steps**: back after 74 archived shows (548 days) [13]
- **Two Soldiers**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 5 archived performances [13]
- **Brokedown Palace**: rare: 4 archived performances [13]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2022-03-15.schoeps_mk41v_flac24** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 159 min [1]
- **billystrings2022-03-15.schoeps_mk22_flac24**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 159 min [2]
- **billystrings2022-03-15.BillyStrings2022-03-15GMan**: audience recording; 25 songs; 159 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the AT 2020 microphones capture a lot, with good timing and placement [9]
- **billystrings2022-03-15.four61ob.flac24**: audience recording; 25 songs; 159 min [4]
- **billystrings2022-03-15.litzenberger.schoepsMK41v.flac24**: source not stated; 25 songs; 158 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the AT 2020 microphones capture a lot, with good timing and placement; Reviewer usually dislikes Schoeps mics but calls this Schoeps recording an exception with excellent sound [10][11]

## Around the show

- Uploader says this was the grand opening of Roadrunner, the newest music venue in Boston [3]
- Uploader notes mixed reviews of the club but was very happy with the experience, and found the place easily [3]
- Billy Strings played the first show at this new Boston venue, which provided a section for tapers [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2022-03-15.schoeps_mk41v_flac24**: taped by Andy Murray; transferred by Andy Murray; source: Schoeps mk41v>cmc1k>Sonosax SX-R4+ (24bit/96khz) left of sbd (din,pas) [1]
- **billystrings2022-03-15.schoeps_mk22_flac24**: taped by Andy Murray; transferred by Andy Murray; source: Schoeps mk22>cmc1k>Sonosax SX-R4+ (24bit/96khz) left of sbd (60 degrees/30 cm) [2]
- **billystrings2022-03-15.BillyStrings2022-03-15GMan**: taped by G Man; transferred by G Man; source: AUD> Audio Technica AT 2020> Tascam DR 40X [3]
- **billystrings2022-03-15.four61ob.flac24**: taped by four61ob; transferred by four61ob; source: AUD > Rode M5(ORTF) > Zoom H5 (24bit/96kHz) > SDHC card [4]
- **billystrings2022-03-15.litzenberger.schoepsMK41v.flac24**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's>Schoeps KCY 250/5i>Schoeps VST62iu>Sound Devices MixPre-3 II [6]
